question: The Election Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2021 belongs to _______ Ministry of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Law and Justice**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Election Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2021 seeks to allow electoral registration officers to seek the aadhaar number of people who want to register as voters for the purpose of establishing their identity.
 
• The bill belongs to **Law and Justice**.
 
• The Election Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2021:
 
 
• Parliament on 21 December 2021 passed the Election Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2021.
 
• It seeks to link electoral rolls with Aadhaar and remove fake voters from electoral rolls.
 
• It proposes to allow election commission officials to seek Aadhaar details of registered voters on a voluntary basis and make the gender-neutral language of the Representation of the People Act, 1950.
 
• The bill will also allow officers to ask for Aadhaar numbers from persons already included in the electoral roll.
 
• Its purpose is to authenticate entries in the electoral roll and to identify the registration of the name of the same person in the electoral roll of more than one constituency or more than once in the same constituency.
